data.fund_type: An open ended equity scheme investing across Large Cap, Mid Cap and Small Cap Companies
data.investment_objective: The primary investment objective of the scheme is to seek to generate capital appreciation & provide long-term growth opportunities by investing in a portfolio of Large Cap, Mid Cap and Small Cap companies. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equity and equity related instruments of Large Cap Companies (including units issued by REITs):- 25-50% Equity and equity related instruments of Mid Cap Companies (including units issued by REITs):- 25-50% Equity and equity related instruments of Small Cap Companies (including units issued by REITs):- 25-50% Debt & Money Market instruments:- 0-25% Units issued by InvITs:- 0-10%
data.exit_load: For redemptions / switch outs (including SIP/STP) within 15 days from the date of allotment of units, irrespective of the amount of investment: 1% No exit load shall be applicable on switches from Regular Plan to Direct Plan and vice versa, under the same scheme.
